changelog:
- Initial release of the sprint-plan skill.
- Provides a concise template and workflow for one-week sprint planning and alignment docs.
- Guides users to define sprint goal, scope, workstreams, metrics, and risks.
- Emphasizes clear structure and direct, bullet-based summaries.
- Avoids day-by-day scheduling unless explicitly requested.
